comment_regular: Verified geometry-decal SaveGame serializes decalCreationData values/path, base lifetime/cell, the persistent targetGeometry scene index, generated mesh vertex/UV/index arrays and skin-partition bone/weight data. This lets LoadGame reconstruct the generated NiTriShape from saved geometry without the transient live-initialization references.
